item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Forecast: Warm & windy work week
item.description: Monday morning is expected to start foggy for many, followed by a mix of sun and clouds, with highs 10 to 15 degrees above normal for this time of year. Mostly cloudy skies are expected for much of the rest of the week as clouds increase Monday night. Tuesday is windy, Wednesday is breezy, and Thursday is windy. This will result in elevated pollen levels and increased wildfire risk. Our next system arrives late week, bringing a chance for showers and storms and a cool down into next weekend.
